items.title: What Does Keysight Technologies (KEYS) New 6G UAV Lab Push Mean?
items.summary: Keysight Technologies (NYSE: KEYS) and Cohere Technologies announced a collaboration to bring multi-UAV 6G sensing capabilities into lab environments. The partnership focuses on integrated sensing and communications emulation for fleets of unmanned aerial vehicles in controlled test setups. Researchers can use the joint platform to validate advanced 6G waveforms and multi-UAV scenarios before moving to field trials. items.title: Keysight Forecasts 20% Revenue Growth for 2027 on Strong Demand
items.summary: View more earnings on KEYS Keysight Technologies Inc. (NYSE:KEYS) reported record fiscal fourth-quarter results on Thursday, beating analyst estimates with adjusted EPS of $3.61 versus $3.37 expected and revenue of $1.994 billion versus $1.946 billion. Orders surged 53% year over year (49% on a core basis), driven by broad-based demand across communications, aerospace and defense, and electronic industrial markets.
